target.title: fix(plugins): pretag pack checks stop hanging on stalled commands
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where release operators running the fast plugin pretag check could have the entire check hang indefinitely when a plugin runtime build, npm pack, or ClawHub pack child process stalled.

## Why This Change Was Made

Each child command now uses the same 10-minute ceiling as the existing npm release-check and shrinkwrap commands, with `SIGKILL` so a child that handles `SIGTERM` cannot keep the synchronous caller blocked. Timeout errors identify the failed release stage and safe command label without forwarding child output or environment details.

## User Impact

Plugin release preflight now exits with an actionable stage-specific timeout instead of blocking indefinitely. Successful builds and packs retain their existing behavior and a full 10-minute per-command budget.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.test.ts` — 3/3 passed.
- `oxfmt --check scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.ts test/scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.test.ts` — passed.
- Targeted Oxlint for `scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.ts` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

### Exact-head real stalled-child proof

Run from PR head `060426878f0ecb8f0ce5ae76e7378340e2bd775f` with Node `v24.16.0`.

The proof harness created a temporary publishable plugin repo whose real `scripts/check-plugin-npm-runtime-builds.mjs` process installed a `SIGTERM` handler, demonstrated that it remained alive after `SIGTERM`, wrote its PID for the parent check, and then stalled. It invoked the exported `runPluginReleasePretagPackCheck()` path from this PR without mocking `execFileSync`. After the changed 600,000 ms deadline returned, the harness checked the recorded PID with `process.kill(pid, 0)`; `childAliveAfter: false` means the timed-out child no longer existed.

Redacted terminal transcript:

```text
$ git rev-parse HEAD
060426878f0ecb8f0ce5ae76e7378340e2bd775f
$ node --version
v24.16.0
$ node --import tsx --input-type=module <real-child-proof-harness>
proof-child: ignored SIGTERM
{"elapsedMs":600122,"code":"ETIMEDOUT","message":"plugin runtime build timed out after 600000ms: node scripts/check-plugin-npm-runtime-builds.mjs","childAliveAfter":false}
```

This transcript proves the changed pretag entry path returns the sanitized stage-specific timeout and terminates the real direct child even when that child handles `SIGTERM`. The separate policy question—whether 10 minutes is the intended maximum for every affected pretag command—still requires maintainer confirmation.

The broader local changed gate passed its preliminary guards, formatting, declaration contracts, and dependency checks, then stopped in the shared dependency install on unrelated type errors in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` and `src/infra/boundary-file-read.ts`. Exact-head CI is the authoritative clean-install typecheck, and CI is green for this head.
